name: Omarchy Control for Nanoleaf
author: Sven Wagener
description: Control Nanoleaf light panels (Shapes, Canvas, Lines, Elements) from the Omarchy bar: on/off, brightness, scenes, colors, white tones and profiles. Talks to the devices over the local Nanoleaf Open API; no cloud. English and German UI.

barWidget.description: Left click opens the panel, right click toggles all lights, scroll changes brightness.

schema.label: Language
schema.description: Auto follows the system language (German or English).
